description:
Company \- https://7ddesign.in/

**About company**

7D Design is an integrated marketing and branding agency specializing in brand building and strategy development. We offer a wide range of services including visual identity, advertising, Social Media Marketing, Content Creation, Influencer Marketing, Perfromance Marketing, Campiagns and Video Production.

Role Description This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru. The Mid\-Level Graphic Designer will be responsible for developing creative concepts and delivering visually striking designs across digital and print platforms.

Responsibilities:

* Create high\-quality graphic designs for social media, digital campaigns, advertisements, and marketing materials.
* Develop and adapt creatives in different sizes and formats for various platforms.
* Design branding materials, mockups, and visual identity elements.
* Create thumbnails, end cards, sales templates, mnemonics, tangles, and wobblers.
* Design print materials including tent cards, paper advertisements, invitations, envelopes, and book designs.
* Develop outdoor advertising materials such as banners and other promotional creatives.
* Create web banners and digital advertisements.
* Develop logo concepts and contribute to brand identity development.
* Support UI/UX design and create visual layouts and mockups where required.
* Develop creative concepts based on campaign objectives and brand guidelines.
* Use AI prompting and other creative tools to explore and develop design concepts.
* Resize, modify, and repurpose existing creatives while maintaining visual consistency.
* Support video shoots, art direction, and other creative production activities when required.
* Assist with sound design, audio recording, and other multimedia requirements where applicable.
* Review influencer scripts and provide creative inputs when required.
* Conduct competitor and creative research to identify new design trends and ideas.
* Collaborate with content, video, and digital marketing teams to execute campaigns.
* Manage multiple design assignments and ensure timely delivery.
* Take ownership of assigned projects from concept development to final delivery.
* Incorporate feedback and make revisions while maintaining design quality and consistency.

Qualifications \& Skills

* 2–3 years of professional experience in graphic design.
* Bachelor's degree in Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field.
* Proficiency in **Adobe Creative Cloud**, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
* Proficiency in **Figma** for UI/UX, layouts, mockups, and digital design requirements.
* Strong understanding of graphic design principles, typography, layout, colour, composition, and visual hierarchy.
* Good understanding of digital, print, branding, advertising, and social media design.
* Strong creative thinking and visual communication skills.
* Ability to independently develop creative concepts based on project requirements.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines without compromising quality.
* Strong attention to detail, consistency, and accuracy.
* Basic understanding of UI/UX, motion graphics, web design, or presentation design is an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI\-powered creative tools and AI prompting for concept development.
* Basic understanding of multimedia production and creative workflows is a plus.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to receive feedback positively and implement revisions effectively.

description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a UX Designer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

UX Designer – Job Description
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

We are seeking a passionate and user\-centric UX Designer to create intuitive, engaging, and accessible digital experiences across web, mobile, and enterprise platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong design thinking with business understanding, user research, interaction design, and visual communication to solve complex customer problems.
  
  

As part of a multidisciplinary product team, you will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Engineers, Researchers, and other Designers to deliver exceptional user experiences that drive customer satisfaction and business outcomes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

User Research Discovery
  
  

* Conduct user interviews, stakeholder workshops, contextual inquiries, and usability testing.
* Translate customer insights into actionable design opportunities.
* Create personas, empathy maps, customer journey maps, and service blueprints.
* Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify user pain points.


Experience Design
  
  

* Design intuitive user flows, task flows, information architecture, and navigation systems.
* Create low\-fidelity wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs.
* Design responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile platforms.
* Ensure accessibility compliance (WCAG 2\.2 AA) and inclusive design principles.


Interaction Design
  
  

* Define interaction patterns, micro\-interactions, and motion behaviors.
* Simplify complex workflows into elegant user experiences.
* Create design specifications and collaborate with developers during implementation.


Design Systems
  
  

* Utilize and contribute to enterprise design systems.
* Maintain consistency across products through reusable components and design standards.
* Collaborate with UI Designers to evolve component libraries and design tokens.


Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and roadmap.
* Partner with Engineering teams throughout implementation.
* Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders and leadership.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, design reviews, and retrospectives.


Validation Optimization
  
  

* Plan and conduct usability testing.
* Iterate designs based on customer feedback and analytics.
* Measure success using UX metrics and product KPIs.


Required Skills
  
  

UX Skills
  
  

* Design Thinking
* Human\-Centered Design
* User Research
* Information Architecture
* Interaction Design
* Wireframing
* Prototyping
* Usability Testing
* Journey Mapping
* Accessibility (WCAG)
* Responsive Design


Design Tools
  
  

* Figma
* FigJam
* Adobe Creative Suite
* Miro
* Maze or UserTesting (preferred)
* Microsoft Office / Google Workspace


Technical Understanding
  
  

* HTML/CSS fundamentals
* Responsive frameworks
* Design systems
* API\-aware design
* Agile/Scrum methodologies


Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3–8 years of experience in UX Design, Product Design, or Interaction Design.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating end\-to\-end UX process and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience designing enterprise, SaaS, mobile, or customer\-facing digital products.


About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.
  
  

NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us. Backed by marquee global investors—Insight Partners, Tiger Global, Lightspeed India, Sequoia Capital, and GSV—we’re revolutionizing livelihood creation across India.

Join us and be part of Apna Advantage, where you’ll help students stay engaged, succeed in their programs, and build meaningful careers.


Personalized Career Journeys: Dedicated career facilitators, AI\-powered job preparation tools, and guaranteed interviews


Join us and be part of Apna Advantage, where you’ll shape careers and make a lasting impact on the lives of jobseekers!


Why Join Our Mission

* Massive Market Potential: Over 3\-4L students pursue online degrees annually in India and this is growing 50% every year
* Consumer Impact Legacy: Build a consumer\-facing business that transforms lives
* Exponential Growth Trajectory: Early\-stage opportunity in a rapidly expanding market

What You’ll Do

* Lead end\-to\-end design strategy and execution across core product areas, aligning user needs with business goals and key performance metrics.

* Architect, scale, and govern our comprehensive design system to ensure visual, interaction, and brand consistency across all platforms.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level designers, fostering a culture of design excellence, critique, and continuous improvement.
* Pioneer the integration of AI tools and workflows into the product design process to accelerate rapid prototyping, testing, and feature delivery.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–5 years of experience in product design, delivering high\-impact B2C or scale\-stage digital products.
* Advanced mastery of Figma, prototyping, motion design, and modern UI/UX design systems.
* Portfolio demonstrating end\-to\-end product ownership, strong systems thinking, strategic decision\-making, and measurable user/business impact.
* Experience shipping products on AI platforms and designing with an AI\-first approach.
* Has worked directly under design leadership and cross\-collaborated with other teams

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
**About the Role:**  
We are looking for a hands\-on Product Designer with strong experience in designing consumer\-facing mobile applications (B2C). You will own end\-to\-end design for key product areas, shaping intuitive, engaging, and scalable user experiences.

This role requires someone who combines product thinking, UX rigor, and visual craft, and has shipped real mobile experiences used by customers.

You’ll work at the intersection of product, engineering, and real user needs to build experiences that are not just usable, but deeply meaningful.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end\-to\-end product design lifecycle: discovery → wireframes → prototypes → final UI
* Design intuitive and engaging mobile\-first experiences (iOS \& Android) for consumer products
* Conduct user research, usability testing, and behavioral analysis to inform design decisions
* Create user journeys, flows, and interaction models for new and existing features
* Translate product requirements into high\-quality UI/UX solutions
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Growth teams
* Contribute to and evolve design systems, components, and patterns
* Use data and insights to iterate and improve user experience and engagement
* Ensure high\-quality handoff and implementation with engineering teams

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8\+ years of experience designing and shipping consumer\-facing (B2C) mobile products
* Strong portfolio showcasing end\-to\-end design projects (mobile\-first)
* Deep understanding of mobile UX patterns, interaction design, and usability principles
* Ability to bring clarity to ambiguity and structure to complex problem spaces
* Strong sense of visual hierarchy, information architecture, and clean design systems
* High ownership mindset, you don’t wait for perfect inputs, you move things forward
* Excellent collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, and stakeholders
* Curiosity\-driven thinking, you question assumptions before jumping to solutions

**What Sets You Apart**

* Experience working on health, wellness, or data\-heavy consumer products
* Ability to design for trust, clarity, and sensitive user contexts
* Strong attention to micro\-interactions and product polish
* A bias for clarity over cleverness, with the judgment to know when to push boundaries

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager, Product Design
description:
**Who we are:**



Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.



Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.



Visit gomotive.com to learn more.


We're looking for a Senior Manager of Product Design to lead our new Maintenance and Fuel vertical and grow our design presence in Bangalore. This role is both hands\-on and organizationally pivotal. You will lead a team of designers working within our growing Maintenance and Fuel vertical, delivering intuitive, scalable experiences across web and mobile platforms.



In parallel, you will serve as a local design leader for South Asia, supporting and mentoring designers across teams, many of whom may report into different managers globally. You'll play a critical role in strengthening design culture on the ground, elevating craft, and ensuring designers in the region feel supported, connected, and set up to succeed. You will also be instrumental in building and scaling our design team in India, helping us attract and hire exceptional talent in a highly competitive market.



You will be pivotal in defining and executing the product strategy, working in close partnership with cross\-functional leaders to deliver exceptional and user\-centric experiences for fleet managers, drivers, and back\-office personnel.



As a design leader who remains highly connected to the craft, you will champion the growth and development of a talented team of designers through effective mentorship and coaching, fostering a high\-performance design culture. You will also be a key driver in the evolution and adoption of AI\-centric product development, ensuring a scalable, unified, and high\-quality user experience across our entire product ecosystem.



Reporting to our VP of Design, you will have the opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team to make a significant impact on our customers' lives and contribute directly to key business objectives. If you have a proven track record of successfully leading strategic design initiatives while remaining connected to the design process and tackling complex challenges, we encourage you to apply.


**What you'll do**


### **Product \& Design Leadership**


* Lead and support a team of designers contributing to our Maintenance \& Fuel domain.
* Drive high\-quality, user\-centered design solutions that simplify complex workflows for fleet managers, drivers, and operations teams.
* Partner with product and engineering to shape strategy, prioritize initiatives, and deliver impactful outcomes aligned with business goals.
* Own design execution end\-to\-end—from early framing and concepting through detailed design, validation, and iteration.
* Align teams around a shared vision through strong storytelling and strategic thinking and communicate design rationale clearly and persuasively to stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Contribute to and evolve our design system to ensure consistency, scalability, and efficiency across platforms.
* Champion the use of modern AI tools to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and delivery.
* Introduce and scale AI\-assisted workflows across design and cross\-functional teams.
* Stay at the forefront of emerging tools and practices, bringing new ideas into the organization.
* Advocate for design excellence and a user\-centric mindset across the organization.

### **Regional Leadership (South Asia)**


* Serve as the on\-the\-ground design leader in Bangalore, supporting designers across multiple teams in the region.
* Mentor and coach designers who may not directly report to you, helping elevate craft, execution quality, and career growth.
* Foster a strong, connected design culture in South Asia, including team rituals, critiques, and knowledge sharing.
* Act as a key connector between regional teams and global design leadership, ensuring alignment and strong collaboration.
* Build, mentor, and manage a high\-performing team of product designers based in Bangalore.
* Help establish Bangalore as a center of excellence for product design within the organization \- playing a hands\-on role in attracting, sourcing, hiring, interviewing, and closing top design talent in India.

**What you'll need**
--------------------


* 8–10\+ years of experience in product design (UX/UI/interaction), with experience managing and growing design teams in a SaaS environment.
* Proven track record designing complex, data\-rich web and mobile products, ideally in fleet management, logistics, or similarly complex domains.
* Experience working with distributed/global teams, with strong collaboration across time zones.
* Demonstrated success hiring and scaling design teams, ideally in India or similar markets.
* Experience mentoring designers across reporting lines or contributing to regional/team\-wide design culture.
* Strong portfolio showcasing:
* + End\-to\-end design thinking
	+ Systems\-level problem solving
	+ High\-quality execution
	+ Measurable business impact
* Deep experience with design systems and scaling them across products and teams.
* Hands\-on familiarity with modern AI tools and workflows, and a strong point of view on how they reshape design and product development.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence across disciplines.
* Strong business acumen and an understanding of how design drives product and company outcomes.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a bias toward action in a fast\-moving environment.

 *Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.*
